steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Human Impact: Human activities such as deforestation, pollution and burning fossil fuels are reducing biodiversity and contributing to global warming. Conservation and sustainable practices are essential to protect ecosystems for future generations.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Define biodiversity and explain why it is important. | Explain three consequences of deforestation. | Describe the greenhouse effect and explain how human activities are increasing global temperatures.
